Chapter 1All staff

Start every day on the dashboard.

One screen tells you what happened, what is still open and who needs attention.

  1. 1✓Check the totals: all, pending and resolved incidents, for today, this week or the whole year.
  2. 2✓Use quick actions to log an incident, recognize a student or run a report in one tap.
  3. 3✓Open the alerts: students at high risk, IEP/504 removal limits and the positive to corrective ratio.
1
2
3

Chapter 2All staff

Know every student at a glance.

The roster and each profile bring points, plans and history together.

  1. 1✓Search the roster by name or student ID, or filter by grade.
  2. 2✓Open a profile to see conduct points, standing and program badges like IEP or BIP.
  3. 3✓Log an incident or recognize the student right from the profile, with their plan in view.
1
2

Chapter 3TeachersCounselorsPrincipals

Log an incident in under a minute.

The form uses the same PlusPortals codes the office enters in the SIS, so nothing is typed twice.

  1. 1✓Pick the student and the infraction code, like PROFAN for profanity.
  2. 2✓Choose the location and the action taken, such as CLS Classroom and OR Office Referral.
  3. 3✓Choose a penalty. Detention hours or suspension days fill in for you, and the served status starts as Pending.
1
2
3

Chapter 4All staffCounselors and principals manage plans

See the plan before any consequence.

IEP, 504, ELL, behavior, gifted and health plans travel with the student.

  1. 1✓Pick a student with a plan and the form shows their needs and behavior guidance first.
  2. 2✓The app warns from day 8 of removal and requires a manifestation determination review past day 10, as IDEA does.
  3. 3✓Open the plan to see every accommodation by type: presentation, setting, timing and behavior.
1
2
3

Chapter 5TeachersCounselorsPrincipals

Follow through, then close it.

Every incident keeps its status, its history and the conversation with home.

  1. 1✓Update the status and save. The status log records who changed what, and when.
  2. 2✓Send to Parent writes the email in Spanish and English, ready to send from your mail.
  3. 3✓Export the record as PDF or Excel, or escalate it to the principal.

Chapter 6Counselors and adminsTeachers can view

Support that grows with need.

Track Tier 1, 2 and 3 interventions with goals, progress checks and end dates.

  1. 1✓See how many students are in each tier, from school-wide prevention to intensive support.
  2. 2✓Create an intervention with a goal, how progress is monitored and exit criteria.
  3. 3✓Filter to the 30-day check-ins that are due, so no review slips.

Chapter 7All staff

Catch students doing the right thing.

Positive behavior is tracked next to discipline, the PBIS way.

  1. 1✓Tap Recognize, pick a student and a value: Respect, Responsibility, Integrity, Kindness, Leadership or Excellence.
  2. 2✓Add points and a short note. It appears in the feed and on the leaderboard.
  3. 3✓Watch the positive to corrective ratio. The PBIS goal is 4 to 1.
1
2
3

Chapter 8All staff

Spot who needs help early.

An early-warning score from incidents, suspensions, MTSS tiers and recognitions. Every point has a reason.

  1. 1✓Start with the tiles: high and moderate risk, IEP/504 removal alerts and the PBIS ratio.
  2. 2✓Manifestation determination alerts list students near or past 10 days of removal.
  3. 3✓Each student lists the reasons behind the score. Recognitions lower it.

2

Chapter 9Any staff member filesCoordinators review

Refer a student to the coordinators.

The Secondary Disciplinary Referral, filed in the app and kept confidential.

  1. 1✓Fill in the referral: the students involved, their strengths, what happened and what you tried.
  2. 2✓Only coordinators see the inbox. Teachers see just the referrals they filed.
  3. 3✓Coordinators move each referral from New to In review to Closed, with notes.

Chapter 10All staffAdmins edit codes

Reports and the school codes.

Ready-made reports for meetings, and the PlusPortals code sets kept in one place.

  1. 1✓Open a ready-made report: by grade, by category, top students or the monthly summary. Print it or save a PDF.
  2. 2✓Export any filtered incident list to Excel.
  3. 3✓Admins keep the infraction, penalty, action, served and location codes in sync with PlusPortals.

Chapter 11ParentsStudents

A private view for families.

Parents see only their own child. Students see only themselves.

  1. 1✓Families sign in and land on their own page, with conduct points and standing.
  2. 2✓They see each incident and recognition, without staff notes or other students’ names.
  3. 3✓The school links each account to the right student. An unverified link shows nothing.

Chapter 12Everyone

Works your way.

On a phone or a computer, in English or Spanish, light or dark.

  1. 1✓Press Ctrl K, or tap Search on a phone, to find any student or screen.
  2. 2✓Switch between English and Spanish with one tap.
  3. 3✓Light and dark mode follow your device, or pick one in Settings.
  4. 4✓Install it on your phone’s home screen and sign in with your fingerprint.

Chapter 13AdminsCoordinators

Private by design.

Every role sees only what it needs, and every account is protected.

  1. 1✓Admins and coordinators create accounts and choose each person’s role.
  2. 2✓A password set by an admin is temporary. Each person chooses their own at first sign-in.
  3. 3✓Ten wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. Changing a password signs out every other device.
